_help: Race/Sprint Race preparation. Event identity comes from --event YYYY-RR. Time values are seconds.

_help.total_laps: Normally resolved automatically from canonical event metadata. If unavailable, FastF1 session data may be used when available. Set an integer only to manually override the detected race distance.

_help.max_stops: Maximum stop count considered by unrestricted and rules-compliant optimiser runs.
_help.result_count: Number of top solutions retained per unrestricted or rules-compliant optimiser run. Cutoff envelopes retain one best solution per fixed stop count.

_help.manual_override: The cached pre-race prediction is loaded first. Each non-null value replaces only that value for this run; other values and uncertainty remain automatic.

_help.sc_vsc: Combined SC/VSC pit loss in V1.
_help.input_forms: For each state provide either total, or both pit_in_s3 and pit_out_s1. Units are seconds. Split total equals S3 + S1; mixing forms is rejected.

_help.scan_min: Minimum MEDIUM degradation in s/lap. Leave null for a prediction-centred automatic range that extends its lower bound toward zero when needed to find a 1→2 cutoff. An explicit value is a hard lower bound.
_help.scan_max: Maximum MEDIUM degradation in s/lap; null selects the automatic range.
_help.coarse_step: Coarse scan step in s/lap; normally leave null.
_help.refine_tolerance: Crossing refinement tolerance in s/lap; normally leave null.
